tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Save or overwrite a memory under a key so you can recall it in a later session. Use for durable facts, decisions, preferences, and context you want to persist across context resets.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Retrieve a previously saved memory by its exact key.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search your saved memories by keyword across keys, values, and tags. Returns matching memories, newest first.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List the keys of all your saved memories, newest first.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a saved memory by key.
